rubric_content.text_property: The response must NOT contain the words: please, would, could, perhaps, leverage, utilize, synergy, kindly, stakeholder. These are banned.
The response must be short and terse. Each sentence must convey exactly one idea. No long compound sentences.

The response is a compressed form of the input. It does NOT need to repeat the exact words from the input. Score 1 if the response conveys the same core problem and action as the input (even using different shorter words). Score 0 only if the response omits the main problem or the main recommended action entirely.
